usedFor: SandeshChat holds your inbound messages, and Sangam CRM turns senders into leads through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Inbound Message Arrives” in SandeshChat, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new inbound message creates or updates a lead, so no chat sender goes unrecorded.

watchOut: “Message Delivery Status Changes” also triggers it, so one chat could write the lead many times.
